info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v1-spec
info.description: The List Credit Card Application Credit Checks API provides a way for financial institutions to efficiently retrieve credit check information related to credit card applications. This endpoint allows users to access critical data needed to assess the creditworthiness of applicants. Typical consumers include financial analysts and application processors who require real-time insights into credit checks. By utilizing this API, institutions can streamline their decision-making processes and enhance their credit evaluation management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of credit check applications submitted by users. You can filter the results based on specific criteria to fetch the relevant applications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a credit check for a specific application. Please ensure that all required fields are provided for accurate processing.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: This schema represents the request body expected for the Credit Check operation using the GET method. It is expected to be a string value.
